user.title: Choose air-quality device
user.description: Choose one device. Canadian Air Quality Index will automatically find compatible sensors on that device and in its area.

confirm.title: Confirm Canadian Air Quality Index
confirm.description: Detected {detected_sources} compatible source types. You can change the name below before creating the integration.

data_description.create_index: Adds the 1-65 Canadian Air Quality Index number. The Air Quality Level sensor is always created.

review.title: Review detected sensors
review.description: IAQCA found {detected_sources} compatible source types. Review or change any selection before continuing.

data_description.co: Multiple sensors are allowed; the highest reading is used.
data_description.pm: Multiple sensors are allowed; their values are combined for scoring.
data_description.air_quality_index: Uses a supported sensor index directly, instead of TVOC or VOC index.
data_description.index_profile: Automatically identifies supported scales. Choose a scale only when device metadata is insufficient.
